🎯 Line bingo

Find the equation. Find it on the card. Chat first, then click!

y = 2x + 4

y = 4x + 2

y = x + 3

y = 3x + 2

y = 3 − x

y = 2x − 4

y = x − 3

y = 4 − 2x

y = 3x − 2

Gradient 2, through (0, 4)?

y = 2x + 4

y = 2x + 4

Gradient −1, intercept 3?

y = 3 − x

y = 3 − x

Up 3 for 1 across, crosses the y-axis at −2?

y = 3x − 2

y = 3x − 2

🎉 BINGO! y = 2x + 4 · y = 3 − x · y = 3x − 2 – a line of three!
